entities.name: Crypt of the Eternals
entities.description: The grand necropolis of Amonkhet beyond the Gate to the Afterlife, where the worthy dead were transformed into Eternals.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the God-Pharaoh ruled and the crypt stands.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The living city of Amonkhet at whose edge the crypt's gate stands.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The ruler of Amonkhet whose final promise to his devoted people the crypt embodied.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker whose plan the Scarab, Scorpion and Locust Gods enact; a statue of him stands in the crypt.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Warriors coated in lazotep, preserved as an immortal army, stripped of memory but retaining martial skill.

entities.name: Anointed
entities.description: Embalmed dead who serve as caretakers, laborers or attendants and tend the necropolis.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: God who led the lazotep-coated dead out of the crypt in the Hour of Eternity.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: God who joined in enacting Nicol Bolas's plan.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: God who joined in enacting Nicol Bolas's plan.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: The event during which the crypt's gates opened and the Eternals were unleashed.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers that fought the crypt's unleashed legions.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god who fought to repel the Eternals.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A defender who fought the crypt's legions.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who visits the crypt after the War of the Spark to overcome the trauma of Gideon's death.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker whose death traumatized Chandra.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle after which Chandra visits the crypt.

entities.name: God Trials
entities.description: Trials in which initiates who died were carried to the crypt.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of the multiverse who opened the crypt.

entities.name: Lazotep
entities.description: A mystical blue mineral mined under the God-Pharaoh's command and used to coat the worthy dead.

events.summary: The worthy dead are carried through the gate on funerary barges, embalmed, coated in lazotep and fitted with weapons to become Eternals.
events.quote: The truly worthy dead, however, received far greater honor.

events.summary: During the Final Hours the sealed gates swing open as the Second Sun aligns with the horns of the monument, revealing an army of Eternals.
events.quote: the sealed gates finally swung open as foretold when the Second Sun aligned with the horns of the God-Pharaoh's monument

events.summary: The Scarab God leads the lazotep-coated dead out to transform Naktamun's people into an undead legion in the Hour of Eternity.
events.quote: the Scarab God led countless generations of lazotep-coated dead out from the crypt

events.summary: The Scorpion God and Locust God join in Bolas's plan; the Gatewatch, Hazoret, Samut and the faithful fight the Eternals.
events.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions

events.summary: After the War of the Spark, Chandra visits the crypt, destroys a stay band of Eternals and obliterates the statue of Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: then obliterated the massive statue of Nicol Bolas inside the crypt

events.summary: During New Phyrexia's invasion of the multiverse the crypt is opened by the Phyrexians.
events.quote: During New Phyrexia's invasion of the multiverse, it was opened by the Phyrexians.

relations.note: Hidden behind the sealed gate at the edge of Naktamun.
relations.quote: Hidden behind the sealed gate at the edge of Naktamun

relations.note: They joined in enacting Bolas's plan.
relations.quote: the Scorpion God and Locust God joined the Scarab God in enacting Nicol Bolas 's plan
the Scorpion God and Locust God joined the Scarab God in enacting Nicol Bolas 's plan

relations.note: They fought to repel the legions.
relations.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions
